title: Competency quality remediation and acceptance
invariants: 383 protocol IDs and 1151 scored action IDs
Canonical parent mappings and curriculum definitions
Assessment model activation and scoring mathematics
Explicit human closeout and credit semantics
Immutable historical evidence and active/paused import protection
Frozen runtime and retained typed-evidence contracts
No participant-data telemetry deployment or fabricated validation
planner_limit: The read-only navigator checks plan structure and declared dependency state only. Production evidence/hash enforcement is M6K-01-02; workflow dispatch is M6K-01-03. No work has run merely because this plan exists.

A.title: Scope, level and progression
acceptance: A1: Every relevant canonical facet has a reasoned teaching/practice/evidence/next-route disposition; alternatives are not treated as simultaneous obligations.
A2: The learner can understand the competency and why the default represents it without the conversation.
A3: Default prerequisites and capability fit are explicit; suitable other routes exist where needed, not a universal trivial task.
A4: Adaptations preserve purpose, role choice, consent, resource realism and safety; an exclusion or referral alone does not cover a missing facet.
A5: Progression and transfer are useful and bounded; no short-task mastery claim, fixed word-count target or compulsory three-level ladder.
A6: Actual content changes and exact facet anchors are supplied; open source/qualified questions remain visible.

B.title: Instructional completeness and professional editing
acceptance: B1: Every promised brief dataset example template model and key is present and resolves by ID; nothing essential is delegated to inventing the intervention.
B2: Worked teaching, practice, unassisted prompts and separately revealed checks are distinct; numerical keys are independently recomputed and wrong answers rejected.
B3: Evidence concerns what was actually attempted; plans, rehearsal, self-attestation and live transfer are not conflated.
B4: Learner copy is clear professional and free of maintainer metadata, unsupported jargon, interchangeable substantive templates and excessive generic warnings.
B5: Setup, pacing, decision points, cost/access, meaningful adaptations and next action are usable without padding or loss of depth.
B6: Scope changes reopen A; instruction/material changes invalidate affected C; scoring and retained evidence remain unchanged.

C.title: Independent cold-start and adversarial review
acceptance: C1: A separate run first receives only learner-visible content, allowed materials and stated prerequisites, without author rationale or this conversation.
C2: Default work is actually desk-tested where possible; required invention and missing dependencies are recorded, not filled from reviewer knowledge.
C3: The supplied rubric distinguishes a competent, partial and plausible incorrect/adverse result; keys are withheld until checking.
C4: Relevant access/resource/role and capability variations retain the goal; scope and neighboring-task distinctness are audited after the cold-start attempt.
C5: Live physical, relational, clinical and longitudinal actions not performed remain untested; no fictional participant, consent or specialist claim.
C6: Blocking findings return to A/B and require fresh C on changed artifacts; pass is agent editorial review, never human or empirical validation.
